lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, yeah, yeah
Little boy with a glove on, look at me dad
Swinging for the fences just to make my pops glad
You ain't in the stands, so I built you in the sky
Turned Yahushua to my coach, trying to catch his eye
Opened up the book, made it into my back
Every verse that I swung was a crack at the fact
That I never hurt, son, I'm proud you're mine
So I sharpened every scripture like a landmine, zeal on ten
But the wound don't bleed, heart full of doctrine, soul full of need
Pointing out sin like I'm saving your name
Really, I was begging you to put me in the game
Told my ex, told my friends what they doing ain't right
But I never let you search my own heart in the light
Used theology as armor, pain as a shield Didn't know my hidden guilt was the sword in the field
Bottle in my hand when the echo got loud When the silence said you failed him, you'll never make him proud
So I drank to forget, then I rode to defend I was swinging at the devil, but I cut up my friends
I just wanna show daddy how high I could climb How hard I could hustle, how pure I could rhyme
Will it is worth from a wound in my chest Till his love cut through and put that pride to rest
No, I'm done with that paid game, frontin' for the crowd
I'm seated in the heavens where the blood cried loud
From a child of performance to a son by grace
He said, well done, before I even ran the race
One night I crashed at the foot of the throne
All my dust says the Lord got thrown like stones
And the same word I used like a bat on the field
Became the two-edged blade that made my secret seal
He replayed every moment I was breathin' down fire
How I covered over fear with a prop at the top
Showed me that the wrath of the saint never heals
It was my father hunger grinding under the wheels
He said, son, you don't guard me, I bled for you
You don't stand in my shadow to improve my view
I was pleased when the nails hit, love already signed
You were carved in my hands before you changed your mind
You been swinging for approval that I gave at the cross
You been preaching like a boss, but living like you lost
Put the bat down, let the glove drop, come here
Let me break that orphan heart and delete that fear
Then the courtroom flip, gavel hit, case closed
All my self-defense speeches got exposed
But instead of condemnation, I heard one thing
Welcome home, my son, feel the joy, you're king
I was trying to show that, how high I could climb
How hard I could hustle, how pure I could rhyme
Really did his work from a wound in my chest
Till his love cut through and put that pride to rest
Now I'm done with that fake game
Frontin' for the crowd, I'm seated in the heavens
Where the blood cried out from a child
A performance to a son by grace
He said, well done, before I even ran the race
Now I step to the plate with a whole new stance
A dead man walking in a resurrection dance No audition for affection, that contract sealed
I'm accepted in the beloved, that's the whole field
Already in the clubhouse, seated with the champ
He lit the scoreboard up before I left the camp
So I ain't gotta flex, when I speak his name I just echo his mercy, that's his game, his
game ain't clout
It's a cross and a crown, where the greatest take towels
And wash feet down, where the hard bars hit like Father forgive
And the hook is his blood, shout and live, child, live
Now when I quote scripture, it's a key
Not a knife, not a bat in my hand
But the bread of life
I don't preach to be right, I confess to be free
I don't judge from the dugout, I invite to the tree
The world's game says earn it, grind till you break
His game says it's finished, drink all that grace
I was trying to make dad proud, swinging in the dark
Now I was in the bleachers with his name on my heart
No more orphan in the mirror with a Bible as a gun
No more sermons as a weapon, no more look what I've done
I'm a son in the light with the scars in his palms
Hear the thunder of his love and the quiet of his psalms
And the quiet of his love and the quiet of his arms
I'm trying to show that we know how high I can climb
How hard I can hustle, how pure I can rhyme
Wheel of this word from a wound in my chest
Till his love cut through and put that pride to rest
Now I'm running this game, not the world's charade
Grace on my jersey is blood on the blade
From a child of performance to a son by grace
He said, well done, the day took my place
Bad, bad, bad daddy
spending good time
I told you
Thank you.
